description: This file defines specific trigger initialization functions for Subaru engines within a fuel injection/ignition control firmware. It contains functions that set up trigger shapes, timing events, and synchronization parameters used in engine diagnostics or control logic.

methods.name: initialize36_2_2_2
methods.description: Initializes a trigger shape object with specific timing events for a 3-2-2-2 Subaru/variant engine configuration, setting synchronization and adding multiple primary events.

methods.name: initializeSubaru7_6
methods.description: Configures a trigger shape object for the Subaru 7-6 engine variant, setting primary and secondary trigger events, synchronization gaps, and triggering conditions.
